messages:
emily_sales: Heads up - GreenHarbor POC scheduled for Tues. They need SSO + SCIM + RBAC validated before signing. Can SE + security triage blockers? https://docs.greenharbor.example/poa :wave

 devon_se: Thanks - want to confirm scope before the call. Quick list: - IdP = Okta (customer says) - SCIM: bulk provisioning + role mappings - SAML: SP-initiated w/ ACS and attribute mapping - Domain controls: tenant claim verification and delegated subdomains?

 emily_sales: Yep that's what Tara said. Also they're asking about dedicated capacity pricing if we need to guarantee <100ms p95 for chat ops.

 tara_gh_admin: @emily_sales correct. Okta org, ~12k users (will ramp). SCIM must support delta sync and initial bulk. Role model: employees + contractors + service_accounts. For SAML, we expect nameID=email and attributes: role, department. Our security team will run questionnaire.

 sam_security: Copy. We need to know: are tokens encrypted at rest with customer KMS? Is Private deployment/ VPC an option for the PII POC? Also any RBAC enforcement hooks for SCIM groups->Redwood roles?

 maria_solutions: We can support customer-managed KMS in Private. For hosted, we offer envelope encryption (our KMS) and HSM options for Enterprise. RBAC mapping: SCIM groups map to role IDs via mapping table in the Console; we can also accept a custom mapping file during onboarding.

 devon_se: Technical notes to confirm with GreenHarbor before POC: 1) SCIM rate/limits and paging - they should expect 100 reqs/min burst by default; we can raise to 1k/min for Dedicated. 2) Initial bulk best practice: run a backfill job hitting our /scim/v2/Users endpoint with pagination. We'll provide a resume token if interrupted. 3) SAML metadata: give them our SP metadata + ACS URL. Example ACS: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs/greenharbor

 devon_se: Quick troubleshooting snippet for them to test SCIM reachability (share in onboarding):
 ```bash
 curl -i -u "scim-client:SECRET" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
   https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=100
 ```

 tara_gh_admin: On rate limits - 1k/min for dedicated sounds good. For hosted POC we need delta sync every 5 minutes. Can hosted meet that without throttling?

 maria_solutions: Hosted can do delta every 5m if you keep changes small; otherwise we recommend dedicated for sustained delta at that frequency. We'll supply a suggested sync cadence in the runbook.

 sam_security: Also need answers for the security questionnaire: - Do you support SCIM over TLS 1.2+? - Are SCIM credentials rotated automatically? - Audit logs for provisioning events (who created/updated/deleted) retained 365 days?

 emily_sales: I'll paste our answers in the questionnaire doc but need confirmation on auto-rotation and retention windows.

 maria_solutions: Answers for now: TLS 1.2+ supported. SCIM credentials: hosted - customer-rotated (we enforce expiry policy), Private - integrate with customer vault for rotation. Audit logs: hosted 90 days by default, enterprise add-on 365d. We can add a bespoke retention clause for contracts.

 devon_se: One more enterprise blocker note: domain verification model. GreenHarbor wants to prevent external sign-ups for certain domains and enforce tenant locking by verified DNS TXT. We support delegated verification (customer uploads proof) and automatic periodic re-checks.

 tara_gh_admin: Good. Also need to confirm RBAC enforcement in runtime - e.g., if SCIM marks a user as 'deprovisioned' do we immediately terminate API keys/sessions? Any grace period?

 sam_security: For security posture we want immediate token revocation on deprovision. What do you do?

 maria_solutions: We can trigger immediate session invalidation for Dedicated and Private; hosted has a configurable grace period (default 5m) to allow propagation. For the POC we can enable immediate revocation.

 deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary/scim-sync-updates -> prod at 2023-11-02T03:00Z (non-prod already has resume token support). :rocket:

 devon_se: Action items: - @maria_solutions: prepare runbook + example mapping JSON for SCIM groups->roles - @sam_security: which questionnaire sections do you own? send edits by EOD Fri - @emily_sales: confirm whether GreenHarbor wants Hosted POC or Dedicated trial (30d).

 emily_sales: I'll ask Tara and get back before EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:

 tara_gh_admin: Quick follow: pricing - what's the delta monthly to enable 1k/min SCIM + dedicated throughput SLA? Need a ballpark for procurement today.

 maria_solutions: Ballpark: +$8k/month for Dedicated baseline to guarantee throughput (subject to final sizing). SCIM bump to 1k/min is +$500/mo. We'll send a formal quote.

 emily_sales: Perfect. I'll relay and schedule a pre-POC technical call Mon.

 tara_gh_admin: Thanks team, saved. We'll bring Okta admin + infra lead to the call.

 emily_sales: Closing thread for now - please ping if anything changes.
